device_entry.name: PTC PCR热循环仪
tags: 基因编辑、分子生物学与育种
device_entry.description: 用于PCR温度循环实验的热循环仪，可读取温度与运行状态，控制热盖开合与压力，并管理、运行和删除仪器中的程序。
device_entry.description_en: A PCR thermal cycler used for temperature cycling experiments. It can report temperature and run status, control heated-lid open/close and lid force, and manage, run, and delete onboard programs.
